Sir
I think the books I most enjoyed in early childhood were Miss Edgeworth’s series of Early Lessons, Frank, Rosamond and Harry and Lucy.
Mrs Whately’s Fairfax family
Anna Ross -
Miss Strickland’s Rival Crusoes
Also very early
Scott’s Poems[^1]
Tales of A Grandfather
The Talisman
Ivanhoe
Robinson Crusoe
Lamb’s Mrs Leicesters School
Tales from Shakespeare
This is all I can recollect of really standard books, which I read when very young

Yours truly

C M Yonge
